_about: AO1990 Bases VIII-IX: graphic accents removed on a closed list of words that previously carried a differential (diacritic) accent, plus the accents that AO1990 explicitly KEPT. Forward (old->new) drops the accent; backward (new->old) restores it only for these specific lemmas (it is otherwise ambiguous, e.g. modern 'para' may be the preposition which never had an accent).
_sources: Acordo Ortografico de 1990, Base IX (acentuacao das paroxitonas) and Base VIII
_kept_note: 'pôr' (verb) vs 'por' (prep); 'pôde' (pret.) vs 'pode' (pres.); 'têm/vêm' (3pl) vs 'tem/vem' (3sg); 'fôrma' (mould) optional circumflex to distinguish from 'forma' (shape).
